guides.title: Start From Zero - 30-Day Wealth Creation Sprint
guides.description: A day-by-day system to stabilise cash, create an offer, make first sales and build the first reserve.
guides.audience: A reader with little or no investable capital who needs reliable surplus cash before investing.
guides.outcome: Finish 30 days with a complete cash map, one tested income offer, a repeatable outreach process and a protected first reserve.

guides.title: The 12-Stage Wealth Creation Roadmap
guides.description: A stage-gated operating system from earning power to transfer, governance and reinvestment.
guides.audience: Anyone who wants to diagnose the next correct wealth-building stage instead of copying an advanced strategy too early.
guides.outcome: Identify the current stage, pass its evidence gate and build a sequenced 12-month plan.

guides.title: Where the Money Is Going - Capital Flow Field Guide
guides.description: How to trace public and private capital without confusing investment themes with investment returns.
guides.audience: Readers researching sectors, careers, businesses or investments influenced by major capital expenditure and policy flows.
guides.outcome: Build a dated capital-flow dashboard and translate it into research questions rather than automatic buy signals.

guides.title: Opportunity Radar - Research Before You Invest
guides.description: A complete evidence funnel for sectors, companies, funds, property and private opportunities.
guides.audience: A reader evaluating an opportunity who needs a disciplined research memo before committing money.
guides.outcome: Produce a sourced opportunity memo containing thesis, valuation, risks, alternatives, loss capacity and stop conditions.

guides.title: How to Invest - Beginner Evidence Guide
guides.description: A safe sequence for goals, risk, products, diversification, fees, custody and annual review.
guides.audience: A first-time investor who needs to understand process before choosing a fund, share, bond, property or platform.
guides.outcome: Create a one-page investment policy and a verified first-investment checklist.

guides.title: Copy the Rich - Principles You Can Adapt
guides.description: What can be copied from large fortunes, what requires scale and access, and what should never be imitated.
guides.audience: A reader seeking practical ownership and capital-allocation lessons without celebrity worship or reckless concentration.
guides.outcome: Choose accessible versions of proven wealth principles while rejecting scale-dependent or destructive tactics.

guides.title: Income Creation Playbook
guides.description: A practical ladder from earning power to recurring revenue, products, intellectual property and ownership income.
guides.audience: A reader who needs to create or diversify income rather than rely on one salary or one customer.
guides.outcome: Build a ranked income portfolio and a 90-day sales pipeline for one primary route.

guides.title: Business Creation Engine
guides.description: A complete system from problem selection and first sale to cash control, operations and responsible scaling.
guides.audience: A founder, sole trader or small team testing a new business or rebuilding an unprofitable one.
guides.outcome: Produce a 90-day launch plan with customer evidence, unit economics, legal checks and cash runway.

guides.description: A purpose-led map of legal ownership, liability, governance, tax, succession and reporting.
guides.audience: A reader deciding whether a company, holding structure, property vehicle, trust, foundation or family arrangement solves a real problem.

guides.audience: A reader planning skills, business or investment research under technological and policy uncertainty.
guides.outcome: Create a scenario dashboard with triggers, opportunities, failure conditions and no-regret actions.
